mentions.name: Countdown Treasure
mentions.description: This is a real-life treasure hunt in the Blue Ridge Mountains with a current prize of $31,200+ in gold coins plus a growing side pot. The search area shrinks daily (from 160 miles wide on day 5 to 1 foot by day 21), and a 24/7 webcam is trained on the jar of gold coins sitting on the forest floor near a public hiking trail. Premium upgrades ($10 each) grant aerial photos of the treasure, access to a private online community, and earlier daily clues while funding the side pot, with $2 per upgrade going toward a $20k Hurricane Helene relief goal. Modeled after Project Skydrop.
